QuestInfo.name: Edelstein Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: #p2152000#, the Headmaster of the school in #m310000000#, is preparing for winter. He may need some help, so go find #b#p2152000##k in #b#m310000000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152000# says that Edelstein winter preparations start with collecting #b#t4031228##k. He asks you to collect #b20 #t4031228##k from monsters, since the Black Wings have made it hard to collect them from the mine.
QuestInfo.2: #p2152000# asked you to help collect #b#t4031228##k for Edelstein's winter preparation. You had to gather the #b20 #t4031228##k from monsters, since the Black Wings have taken control of the mine.\nWith the #t4031228# delivered to #p2152000#, the people of Edelstein have a shot at a warm winter.

0.0: It's been a cold winter. It's especially cold in Edelstein, since we're surrounded by mountains. For generations, the people here have collected #b#t4031228#s#k to protect themselves from the cold. However, that hasn't been easy since the Black Wings have taken control of the mine.
0.1: Still, there is one other way to obtain them. As rare as it is, you can occasionally obtain #b#t4031228#s#k from monsters. If only we could obtain #b20 #t4031228#s#k... #h0#, can you help our town?

yes.0: Please gather #b20 #t4031228#s#k from the monsters nearby. They'll be hard to find, but the townspeople are counting on you.

no.0: I suppose we'll just have to tough it through the winter with dry tree branches.
